# VerificationGlue repository

> Four .NET packages for tests: `VerificationGlue` for assertions with generated failure messages, `VerificationGlue.Mocks` for source-generated mocks, `VerificationGlue.Tests` for a test runner, and `VerificationGlue.Tests.AspNetCore` for testing an ASP.NET Core app from a test parameter. Each package carries its own `llms.txt`. `VerificationGlue.Tests.AspNetCore` is designed in `docs/design/aspnet.md` and is not built yet.

## Packages

- [VerificationGlue](src/VerificationGlue/llms.txt): `Verify`, `Check`, `Throws` and `VerifyScope`. The agent guide for writing checks.

## Rules

- Write test code against the docs under `docs/guide/`. Every code block there comes from a project under `samples/` that CI builds and runs.
- A diagnostic ID such as VG0003 has a page at `docs/diagnostics/<ID>.md` with the cause and the fix.
- Design documents under `docs/design/` describe planned work. Check the phase checklists there before relying on a feature that a guide does not show.
